newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GWA sees 10 pct fall in yr net profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GWA sees 10 pct fall in yr net profit.

text.p: GWA International Ltd said on Wednesday it expected a 10 percent fall in 1996/97 (July/June) net profit.
"We see our full year profit down 10 percent," GWA managing director Geoff McGrath told reporters.
"But this is not a life sentence," McGrath said.
He said estimates for 1997/98 were for an improvement and good growth from core businesses.
"We see improving profitability over the next three years," McGrath said.
Exports by the bathroom fittings unit Coroma rose 57 percent in the latest half year to December 31 and GWA was considering a purchase of an exisitng player, probably in Asia.
McGrath did not say how much might be spent on a purchase.
"With a bit of good management we can take Coroma out of Australia and make it an international operation."
